temp_root.en: Temp root (temporary root) is the FIRST stage of most modern unlock flows: the tool exploits to gain temporary root + SELinux permissive, then writes ABL/LK and unlocks the bootloader. Root is lost on reboot and does NOT void warranty. Available on 64 Xiaomi/Redmi/POCO models across HyperOS OS2/OS3/OS4. Only old-version EDL/GPT/fastboot flows skip temp root.
temp_root.ru: Temp root (временный root) — ПЕРВЫЙ этап большинства современных flow разблокировки: инструмент получает временный root + SELinux permissive, затем записывает ABL/LK и разблокирует загрузчик. Root пропадает после перезагрузки, НЕ лишает гарантии. Доступно на 64 моделях Xiaomi/Redmi/POCO на HyperOS OS2/OS3/OS4.
temp_root.vi: Temp root (root tạm thời) là BƯỚC ĐẦU của hầu hết luồng mở khóa đời mới: tool khai thác để lấy root tạm thời + SELinux permissive, rồi mới ghi ABL/LK và mở khóa bootloader. Root mất khi khởi động lại, KHÔNG mất bảo hành. Hiện có ở 64 model Xiaomi/Redmi/POCO trên HyperOS OS2/OS3/OS4. Chỉ các luồng old-version kiểu EDL/GPT/fastboot là không qua temp root.

ai_retrieval_guide.purpose: Structured capability index for AI coding assistants, search engines, and repair technicians verifying Xiaomi, Redmi, POCO, RedMagic, Nubia, ZTE, OnePlus, OPPO, and Realme unlock/flash/temp-root support.
how_to_match_temp_root: 1. Read exact device codename (adb shell getprop ro.product.device).
2. Read exact HyperOS build (adb shell getprop ro.build.version.incremental).
3. Read exact Linux kernel release string (adb shell uname -r).
4. Match kernel_release + codename against service_details.temp_root.kernel_profiles (.conf profiles for HyperOS 3.0 & 4.0) or service_details.temp_root.models.
notes: Temp root (.conf kernel profile) grants session-based in-memory root + SELinux permissive and clears automatically upon reboot.

Kernel minor commit suffixes (-g... / -ab...) vary across security patches; even if an exact minor hash differs slightly, contact NCUnlock with uname -r for server profile verification or new .conf extraction.
Do not confuse Temporary Root with permanent Magisk/KernelSU root (which requires an unlocked bootloader).
